title: resolver task adjudicate (resolver-adjudicate/1)
description: Structured output of the resolver's adjudicate task (docs/outliner-design.md §5.6): a decision on each parser-report entry the rules could not settle (ambiguous target, list vs division). 'attach' names the node the announcement divides and gives its children in text order; 'ignore' leaves the outline unchanged. Merge rules (outline/resolver.py): the target must exist; the children must lie inside the target's span and must not interleave with the target's existing children; each child confidence < 1 with a non-empty rationale.

target_node_id.description: attach: the node the announcement divides; ignore: null.

heading_src.description: Short classical Chinese heading in kepan style (e.g. 初明…, 次…, 後…).

start.description: First line of the child's span, a linehead exactly as shown in the request (no ':offset'): root text in sutra mode, the outlined text in self-outlining mode, the commentary for commentary-internal targets.

end.description: Last line of the child's span (inclusive), a linehead from the same text as start.

explained.description: Sutra mode: the commentary linehead where the commentary takes this child up, or null. Self-outlining mode: the line inside the child's span where the text's own treatment of it begins, when that is not its first line; null = its start.

confidence.description: Calibrated probability that this child is right; the pipeline accepts only values below 1.

rationale.description: The textual cue relied on, quoting the Chinese; stored as the node's evidence. Must not be empty.

children.description: attach: the announced children in text order; ignore: [].

rationale.description: Why the entry is (not) a division of that node, quoting the Chinese.
